business_problem: Bold is an Argentine deep-tech startup building the agricultural financing AI infrastructure that turns Earth observations data into credit intelligence for financial institutions across Latin America.
solution_summary: Their platform runs on two internal layers: Daredevil, the Earth-sensing layer that ingests and processes signals, and Thot, the AI agentic layer that turns those signals into actionable economic intelligence. "When you are building something nobody has built before, there is no manual," says Kevin Canova, CTO and co-founder of Bold. "You figure out the architecture, you test it, and then you need infrastructure that does not collapse when the data starts coming in at scale." With Google Cloud in place, Bold built a pipeline that takes raw signals and turns them into credit-ready intelligence in near real time. The process starts with Daredevil ingesting signals from satellites and data streams across millions of hectares. That data flows into BigQuery , which serves two roles simultaneously: a data warehouse that stores and organizes the geospatial information, and a feature store that exposes the right data the moment a request comes in.
